question: Jo earns 47 cents a day for feeding the cat, 60 cents a day for walking the dog, and 78 cents a day for washing up. She saves all of it for 7 days. She then shares her savings equally among herself and 4 friends. After that her grandmother gives Jo 13 cents. How many cents does Jo have?

Kim gets 81 cents a day in pocket money and earns 20 cents a day for chores. Each day she spends 60 cents on the bus, a little over half a dollar, gets 22 cents back from bottles, and spends 58 cents on a snack. She saves whatever is left every day for 8 days. How many cents does Kim save?

A teacher had 152 stickers and bought 48 more. She shared them equally among 4 pupils. The class has a dozen tables. Kai traded each of his stickers for 3 smaller stickers. He then got 61 stickers from a friend, and gave 198 stickers to his sister. How many stickers does Kai have?

A farmer sows 51 seeds in each row and 3 rows in each bed, and adds 23 seeds around the edge of every bed. There are 9 beds in a field and 3 fields on the farm, which she checks twice a day. She also sows 20 seeds in a tub. Every seed grows into a plant with 3 pods. How many pods does the farm produce?

Nat had 201 cents and earned 47 cents more, nearly two and a half dollars. He gave half of his money to his sister. At the arcade every cent he had left bought 4 tokens. He spent 318 tokens on racing games and 174 tokens on a crane game. The attendant then doubled the tokens he had left. How many tokens does Nat have?

Tom practised the guitar for 44 minutes on Monday, 47 minutes on Tuesday, and 45 minutes on Wednesday, a little over two hours in all. His teacher asked him to do half of that total again next week, spread equally over 4 days. How many minutes should Tom practise on each of those days?

Marcus bought 2 stamp albums at an auction, and each album held 186 stamps. He sorted every stamp equally into 4 display boxes and decided to keep just 1 of the boxes for himself. His friend Elena has 34 fewer stamps than Marcus keeps in that 1 box, so Marcus's box is the bigger collection of the two. At a stamp fair the following weekend, Elena bought 28 more stamps. How many stamps does Elena have now?

In a trivia tournament, Hana's team started the final day with 238 points on the scoreboard. In the morning quiz they earned 22 points, and in the lunchtime quiz they earned 31 more. A penalty for a late answer then cost them 218 points, and a second penalty cost them 35 points, which put Hana's team behind Leo's team for the first time all day. In the lightning round every point on Hana's team's scoreboard was worth 8 points, and after that a bonus question added 13 points. How many points did Hana's team have on the scoreboard at the end of the day?

Amir and Beatriz spent Saturday picking apples at their uncle's orchard. Amir picked 58 apples before breakfast, 44 more before lunch, and 30 in the afternoon, while Beatriz spent most of the day chatting with the 5 farm workers. Feeling generous, Amir gave half of his apples to Beatriz, so the two of them ended the day with equal amounts. Beatriz divided her apples equally into 3 crates and drove 1 crate to her grandmother, who already had 38 apples in her kitchen. How many apples does her grandmother have now?

Early in the morning, the Casa Rosa food truck prepared 3 trays of tacos with 35 tacos on each tray. Late in the morning the cook made 69 more tacos, and at noon she made another 15. During the busy afternoon the truck sold 139 tacos. In the evening the cook made 24 more tacos for the late crowd. How many tacos did the truck have on hand at the end of the evening?

At the school fair, the price of a lemonade was set at 185 cents in the morning, and a 15-cent cup charge was added on top of that. In the afternoon the organisers cut the price by 137 cents to clear stock, and then knocked off another 15 cents. In the evening they announced a half-price deal, halving the price again. The fair had 320 visitors that day. Just before closing, Marta bought 5 lemonades at the evening price and paid in cents rather than dollars because the stall had no notes, remembering that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents did Marta pay in total?

Petra started the week with 12 dollars in her purse. Her friend Jonas had 6 dollars less than Petra, so Petra was the richer of the two. Jonas spent 2 dollars on a bus ticket and then earned 64 dollars washing cars over the weekend. His mother, who always pays him in dollars rather than cents because she says counting one hundred cents to the dollar takes too long, gave him 50 dollars for his birthday, and his grandfather gave him 80 dollars. How many dollars does Jonas have now?

On Monday morning, courier Sam mapped out a new delivery route made of 6 stretches of 24 kilometres each. Later that morning the dispatcher added a 64-kilometre detour to a farm, and at noon a 56-kilometre extension to the port. In the afternoon Sam found a bridge that cut 160 kilometres off the route. In the evening he agreed to drive the finished route 8 times every week for the next 6 weeks. How many kilometres will Sam drive on this route over those 6 weeks?

On Tuesday morning the Sunrise Bakery's first oven turned out 74 loaves, and a second batch from the same oven added 28 loaves. The bakery has 3 identical ovens, and each of the other ovens produced exactly the same morning total as the first. The bakery employs 9 people. In the afternoon the bakers made 13 rye loaves, 59 sourdough loaves, and 56 baguettes on top of the morning's output. In the evening the manager worked out that Tuesday's total was typical, and that the bakery would produce exactly the same total on each of the 7 days of the coming week. How many loaves will the bakery produce over those 7 days?

Ines packed a jar of honey weighing 124 grams into a box, and the box and padding added 46 grams to the package. Her brother Luca's parcel of preserves weighed 5 times as much as Ines's whole package, so his was by far the heavier of the two. Every delivery day Luca ships a double order, meaning 2 parcels of that weight, and there are 4 delivery days each week. He kept that up for 3 weeks. Luca weighs everything in grams even though the courier charges by the kilogram, and he knows that one thousand grams make a kilogram. How many grams did Luca ship in total over those 3 weeks?

On Monday morning Tomas had 49 kilograms of clay in his pottery studio, and the morning class used 16 kilograms of it. In the afternoon a supplier delivered 12 kilograms more. Tomas then divided all the clay he had equally among 3 shelves, one for each of his evening classes. The studio has 8 pottery wheels. In the evening only 2 of those classes actually ran, and each one used up its whole shelf of clay. Tomas records clay in kilograms rather than grams, reminding students that one thousand grams make a kilogram. How many kilograms of clay did the evening classes use?

In the morning Ada sowed 9 rows of corn in her first field, putting 126 seeds in each row. She has 5 fields in total and sowed every one of them in exactly the same way that morning. In the afternoon she sowed 27 extra seeds in a corner patch while a dozen crows watched from the fence. Her tractor is 14 years old. In the evening she placed an order for next spring, asking for 4 times as many seeds as she had sown that whole day. How many seeds did Ada order?

The Orion cinema has 216 seats in its main hall. For the festival week, 98 seats are permanently reserved for sponsors and 17 seats are out of order, so those cannot be sold. The cinema runs 8 screenings a day in the main hall, and the festival lasts 5 days. A dozen ushers work in the hall during the festival. How many seats in total can be sold to the public over the whole festival?

A factory machine stamps 236 bottle caps every minute, and the factory runs 4 identical machines side by side. Each production cycle lasts 7 minutes. Half of the caps from every cycle fail inspection and are melted down, and only the rest are packed. The factory runs 9 cycles per shift and 7 shifts per week, and the current contract runs for 7 weeks. The manager tracks output per minute but reports it per hour, reminding the crew that sixty minutes make an hour. How many caps will be packed over the whole contract?

A conference keynote was planned to last 48 minutes, but the organiser cut 12 minutes for the opening speech and 24 minutes for the sponsor video. The remaining time was shared equally among 6 presenters, so each presenter got the same short slot. On top of that slot, every presenter is given 57 minutes of questions from the audience. Ana is one of the presenters, and she repeats her full slot plus questions once a day on each of the 7 days of the conference. The schedule is written in minutes rather than hours, since sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes does Ana spend on stage over the whole conference?

In the morning Grace picked 76 strawberries at the farm and then 57 more before the sun got hot. Her brother Hugo, working the bigger field, picked 6 times as many strawberries as Grace did all morning, so his basket was far heavier than hers. In the afternoon Hugo sold 128 of his strawberries to a passing cyclist. In the evening he sold every strawberry he had left at the village market for 3 cents each. How many cents did Hugo earn at the market?

In the morning a market stall had 17 melons on display. The stallholder sold 11 melons before ten o'clock and 4 more just before lunch. In the afternoon a farmer delivered 46 melons to the stall. In the evening the stallholder cut every melon she had into 4 equal wedges to sell at the night market. How many wedges did she have for the night market?

Mia had 154 dollars in her savings account and then deposited another 16 dollars. Her cousin Noah had twice as much money as Mia had after that deposit, so Noah was the richer of the two. Noah's grandmother, who thinks in dollars rather than cents because one hundred cents to the dollar is too fiddly for her, then doubled whatever Noah had. The electronics shop is 15 minutes from Noah's house. Noah spent 547 dollars there on a laptop. How many dollars does Noah have left?

Kai's video clip was 127 seconds long. He added a 3-second title card at the start, then cut out a 99-second scene that dragged, and trimmed another 3 seconds of dead air. Finally he added 35 seconds of credits at the end. Kai edits in seconds rather than minutes, even though the sharing site displays the length in minutes, since sixty seconds make one minute. How many seconds long is the finished clip?

On Saturday morning Kim baked 154 cupcakes for the charity fair, and Jun, who runs a much bigger stall, baked 9 times as many cupcakes as Kim did. Jun's stall is 12 metres long. In the afternoon Jun gave 244 cupcakes to the local shelter and sold 1137 cupcakes to visitors. In the evening a customer brought back 4 cupcakes that had been bought by mistake. How many cupcakes did Jun have left at the end of the evening?
